anyOf.description: A scalar function defined inline. Each task's output expression must return a number in [0,1]. The function's output is the weighted average of all task outputs using profile weights. If there is only one task, its output becomes the function's output directly.

A vector function defined inline. Each task's output expression must return an array of numbers summing to ~1. The function's output is the weighted average of all task outputs using profile weights. If there is only one task, its output becomes the function's output directly.
